dct_description_sm: This project aimed at providing local knowledge of permafrost and climate change to the community by educating community members on how permafrost is altered through climate change and anthropogenic disturbances. It developed principles of pre-construction permafrost investigations, including the different types of foundation techniques on permafrost and how to assess post-construction infrastructure geotechnical performance. Finally, it launched a 'Learning and Evaluation Situation' on permafrost through the school board to target and engage Inuit Youth.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation

dct_title_s: Life on permafrost in Nunavik: community planning empowerment
